evidence_summary: HTTP 200 responses accepting wrong types for multiple scalar fields: string to Double, string/int to Bool, string to Int16
rationale: Log shows REST API accepting type mismatches with implicit coercion across 4 test cases: dbl_f='3.14159' (string to Double), bool_f='true' (string to Bool), bool_f=1 (int to Bool), i16_f='42' (string to Int16), all with code=0; API performs unsafe implicit type coercion instead of rejecting type mismatches for Double/Bool/Int16 fields
